vetSays.line: 🛡️ Michelle, the person in their 60s, the woman in her 50s and Sofia met them at the door — 4 put down. Michelle, the person in their 60s, the woman in her 50s, Sofia are hurt.
🛡️ Michelle, Mai, Ivanka, Elena and Henry met them at the door — 5 put down. Michelle, Mai, Ivanka, Elena, Henry are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Michelle, Mai, Ivanka, Andriy and Sofia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Michelle, Mai, Ivanka, Andriy, Sofia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Michelle just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Michelle, Mai, Ivanka, Andriy and Sofia met them at the door — 4 put down. Ivanka didn't come back. Michelle, Mai, Andriy, Sofia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Michelle just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sofia just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Michelle, Mai, Andriy, Sofia and Elena met them at the door — 5 put down. Michelle, Mai, Sofia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sofia just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Michelle just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nathan just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ingrid just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Michelle, Mai, Nathan and Ingrid met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Michelle, Mai, Nathan, Ingrid are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

regDeaths.name: two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a heron that isn't quite there when you look at it
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
a gold flash in the grass, gone when you look
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
a heron that isn't quite there when you look at it
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
